basis.observed_failure: All 13 live_status_event test records were predicted REVIEW_COMPLETED; train had zero live_status_event records.
basis.not_a_cause: Token truncation: maximum input length was 94 tokens, below 256.

scope: Operational routing only; no scientific outcome judgments or autonomous command execution.
collection_plan: Collect genuine live status snapshots and execution outcomes across multiple new physical experiment runs and profiles.
Include actual running, completed, partial-budget, failure and explicit human-decision records only as they naturally occur; never manufacture failures or approvals to balance labels.
Retain source paths, exact payload hashes, event IDs, timestamps, task profile and configuration/run fingerprint for every record.
Distinguish OBSERVED_REAL_EVENT from DERIVED_FROM_REAL_ARTIFACT; report separate metrics for both, and do not count adjacent epochs as independent incidents.
Use exact output artifact roots and run fingerprint/profile for grouping; task ID prefix alone is not a trustworthy profile identifier.
Have an operator inspect ambiguous labels when such records exist; never mark automatic policy labels human-approved.
split_plan: V1 inspected test is now development evidence for any V2 design; it must not be reported as untouched V2 evaluation.
Preassign new whole physical runs to train, validation and a future untouched holdout before extracting epochs or formatting examples.
Keep overlapping histories, status snapshots, final artifacts and copied aliases from each run in the same group.
Ensure validation contains genuine live-status formats as well as epoch/result formats; with insufficient run groups, postpone a learned-router generalization claim.
Preserve all V1 files and adapters, publish V2 to a new versioned directory, and never overwrite a published corpus.
evaluation_plan: Compare learned predictions with majority class and exact deterministic observed-state policy baselines.
Report confusion matrix, recall per action, performance per artifact type, uncertainty/abstention and run-level support counts.
Missing action classes and poor live-format coverage are explicit production-gate failures, regardless of overall validation accuracy.
Continue deterministic routing for structured lifecycle states; learned model remains advisory until independently evaluated on supported tasks.
